threeProblems.gitOwnedApproach: Prepare permitted source/configuration proposals, typed Work and evidence as a complete committed tree; review and read exact immutable commit/tree through existing readers; explicit reference publication/integration.
threeProblems.nativeResidual: Actual live private configuration selection/apply and reader behavior stay native owner; Git candidate readiness alone is not activation.

threeProblems.gitOwnedApproach: Separate branch/worktree per owned change, explicit affected ownership/dependency and semantic transition checks, accountable integration with expected source/ref CAS; preserve independent valid work.
threeProblems.nativeResidual: Branches do not themselves govern writers of one shared untracked live pathname or revoke already-open writable FDs. A finite existing native-owner operation requires its own actual scope and observations.

threeProblems.gitOwnedApproach: Retain original captures, logical IDs, historical Spec/Plan revisions, immutable source/evidence references and effect fences in existing Git custody; preserve reachable refs and release pins under owner policy.
threeProblems.nativeResidual: Native original/evidence/session/credential owners and consumed/uncertain effects retain their owners. Git data does not authenticate native authorship or grant replay permission.

excludedExpansion: A universal full-filesystem CAS/lease/kernel lock system

qualityCriteria: Git-owned readers consume a complete intended tree, never an unreviewed partial candidate.
Late source/ref/dependency changes preserve third states and independent valid work.
Original meaning and historical contracts survive integration and recovery.
Correct normal consumer progress is retained; more HOLDs alone are not quality improvement.
Any remaining native guarantee is stated at the actual owner/operation boundary with evidence and uncertainty.
Do not confuse a fixture-proven limitation with an observed production failure or a mandatory universal guarantee.
